feature: Human project names in Accounting charts

flows.name: Recognize project exposure by name
steps: Confirm Accounts Receivable uses human project names
Confirm Accounts Payable uses human project names
Confirm full project names and values remain available without raw identifier fallbacks
Inspect the chart pair at desktop and mobile widths
flows.expectedOutcome: Accounting users can recognize every project from its human name, including safe missing-name states, without code-only labels or responsive regressions

checks: AR labels are human project names
AP labels are human project names

claims.description: AR and AP chart labels use the shared human project display-name contract
Missing project names never fall back to raw IDs or codes
Authenticated Accounting route remains readable without overflow at desktop and mobile widths
